info.name: NEXUS - Risk Scoring Service
info.description: AI-powered user risk profiling. Computes composite risk scores (credit, behavioral, compliance, velocity). All endpoints are internal — not exposed to end users. Port: 8094

request.description:
Returns the latest risk profile for a user.

Response 200: RiskProfile {
  userId, computedAt,
  overallRiskScore: BigDecimal (0.0-1.0),
  riskTier: VERY_LOW | LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | VERY_HIGH,
  confidenceLevel: BigDecimal,
  creditRiskScore: { score, grade, details },
  behavioralRiskScore: { score, anomalyFlags },
  complianceRiskScore: { score, kycStatus, sarFlags },
  velocityRiskScore: { score, hourlyTransactionCount, dailyVolume }
}
Response 404: Not Found (no profile yet)

Quick risk tier lookup from Redis cache. Falls back to database if cache miss.

Response 200: { userId: String, riskTier: String (VERY_LOW | LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | VERY_HIGH | UNKNOWN) }

All historical risk profiles for a user, newest first.

Response 200: List<RiskProfile> sorted by computedAt descending

Manually trigger the nightly risk scoring batch job. Normally runs at 2 AM America/Mexico_City.

Response 200: { status, jobId, triggeredAt, estimatedDuration }

Current status of the nightly batch scoring job.

Response 200: { status: String, lastRunAt, nextRunAt, processedCount, failedCount }
